limitations: Sizes are observations at the CI-archive commit before this small final report/source receipt commit, not peak resource consumption.
Reachable object delta reports Git encoded object sizes relative to the baseline. These objects may be shared with other task branches; this is not exclusive physical attribution.
The common Git directory includes all repository/task history and worktree metadata. Its allocation must not be attributed solely to this research branch.
Case counts include existing local collector bookkeeping; decoded corpus bytes and integrity coverage are separately specified by the final integrity receipt.
